supply_reflection_submission_from_R1_cap.node_purpose: Map only the preserved Supply R1 reflection draft into the shared strict reflection surface without changing its research judgment.
supply_reflection_submission_from_R1_cap.input_scale: One complete Supply draft, the exact role catalog, FeedbackReceipts, authority enums and locally eligible stop controls.
supply_reflection_submission_from_R1_cap.required_outputs: One valid Supply reflection submission preserving the captured analysis and all authorized references.
supply_reflection_submission_from_R1_cap.schema_burden: Nested answered questions, graph hypotheses and bounded next-request control must remain equivalent to the local Runtime contract.
supply_reflection_submission_from_R1_cap.materiality_quality_risk: A mapping error could hide the one uncovered bilateral relationship request or change a gap into a false stop.
supply_reflection_submission_from_R1_cap.comparable_run_evidence: R3 successfully mapped Operating, Value and Cash reflections through the same non-thinking submission profile.
supply_reflection_submission_from_R1_cap.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA non-thinking submission profile because no new financial reasoning is authorized in this mapping node.
supply_reflection_submission_from_R1_cap.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one Tool Call and zero retry; any reference, stop-state or truncation failure consumes the attempt and fails closed.

supply_followup_reflection_analysis.node_purpose: Analyze the one newly executed Dell-subject relationship request and determine its effect on the Supply specialist judgment.
supply_followup_reflection_analysis.input_scale: One current S1/S2 response, its FeedbackReceipts, the prior Supply reflection and the bounded three-request catalog.
supply_followup_reflection_analysis.required_outputs: A substantive second-round reflection covering support, unresolved gaps, mechanism, counterevidence and a justified stop proposal.
supply_followup_reflection_analysis.schema_burden: The draft preserves current Evidence and gap refs while keeping compact graph predicates separate from narrative research use.
supply_followup_reflection_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: This is the only uncovered Supply proposition; shallow reasoning would leave the six-role judgment materially incomplete.
supply_followup_reflection_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R3 Cash exhausted 16000 generated tokens while successful Operating and Value drafts used more than ten thousand reasoning tokens plus visible output.
supply_followup_reflection_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking-max with a 32000 generated-token ceiling so required research is not silently truncated for cost or speed.
supply_followup_reflection_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One natural draft and zero retry; length or missing Tool draft is captured as terminal and cannot be completed by Harness.

supply_followup_reflection_submission.node_purpose: Map the completed Supply round-two natural reflection into the strict reflection submission contract.
supply_followup_reflection_submission.input_scale: One new Supply reflection draft plus the exact second-round schema, request catalog and authority enums.
supply_followup_reflection_submission.required_outputs: One valid model-owned reflection with locally bound round and schema identity and no new financial judgment.
supply_followup_reflection_submission.schema_burden: The request catalog is exhausted and open gaps remain, so only the locally eligible terminal state may be submitted.
supply_followup_reflection_submission.materiality_quality_risk: Changing the conclusion or hiding a gap would corrupt the Supply workpaper and subsequent Lead comparison.
supply_followup_reflection_submission.comparable_run_evidence: R3 completed four strict reflection mappings with the same non-thinking profile and zero schema drift.
supply_followup_reflection_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA non-thinking submission profile because this step only maps a completed research draft.
supply_followup_reflection_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one Tool Call and zero retry; added authority, invalid reference or truncation fails closed.

remaining_specialist_workpaper_analysis.node_purpose: Produce the two unfinished decision-ready natural workpaper drafts for Cash Conversion and Supply Relationship.
remaining_specialist_workpaper_analysis.input_scale: Each role receives its complete reviewed Evidence, numeric authorities, relations, gaps, reflections, method and graph context.
remaining_specialist_workpaper_analysis.required_outputs: Thesis, sourced claims, mechanism, alternatives, strongest counterarguments, what-would-change and cross-role challenges.
remaining_specialist_workpaper_analysis.schema_burden: The workpaper contains nested claim and challenge arrays and must preserve role scope and reference authority.
remaining_specialist_workpaper_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: These are substantive research nodes; insufficient reasoning yields a formally tidy but commercially weak combined report.
remaining_specialist_workpaper_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: R3 Cash used all 16000 tokens as reasoning; Operating succeeded with 10211 reasoning and Value with 11451 plus roughly four thousand visible-output tokens.
remaining_specialist_workpaper_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking-max with max_tokens 32000, no retry and full capture-first preservation.
remaining_specialist_workpaper_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: One natural draft per unfinished role; any truncation remains terminal and cannot be promoted or locally completed.

remaining_specialist_workpaper_submissio.node_purpose: Map the Cash and Supply natural drafts into strict model-owned Workpaper fields without changing research judgment.
remaining_specialist_workpaper_submissio.input_scale: Each mapper receives one completed draft, the compact validated context and exact reference-constrained schema.
remaining_specialist_workpaper_submissio.required_outputs: One contract-valid workpaper preserving thesis, claims, mechanisms, counterarguments, what-would-change and authority refs.
remaining_specialist_workpaper_submissio.schema_burden: Large nested arrays and reference enums require a dedicated mapping call with local identity binding.
remaining_specialist_workpaper_submissio.materiality_quality_risk: The mapper may not add or remove a financial conclusion; any content or reference drift blocks Lead.
remaining_specialist_workpaper_submissio.comparable_run_evidence: R3 successfully submitted Demand, Operating and Value workpapers through this same non-thinking contract mapper.
remaining_specialist_workpaper_submissio.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA non-thinking submission profile to maximize contract fidelity and avoid re-reasoning the draft.
remaining_specialist_workpaper_submissio.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one Tool Call per unfinished role and zero retry; invalid JSON, new refs or truncation fails closed.

lead_coordination_analysis.node_purpose: Compare all six valid specialist workpapers, identify material cross-role conflicts and route justified repairs to their original owners.
lead_coordination_analysis.input_scale: Six bounded workpapers and a deterministic challenge catalog; a second round sees only the authority-preserving repaired set.
lead_coordination_analysis.required_outputs: Accepted challenge identifiers, coordination rationale and a proceed, repair or data/tool pause judgment.
lead_coordination_analysis.schema_burden: Lead selects only catalog-bound challenges and cannot invent facts, references or unowned research tasks.
lead_coordination_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: Weak synthesis can miss contradictions or over-repair sound roles and directly degrade the final multi-agent judgment.
lead_coordination_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: The zero-call multi-agent proof required one Lead challenge and one role-local repair before evaluation readiness.
lead_coordination_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking-max with max_tokens 32000 because cross-role comparison and materiality need substantive reasoning.
lead_coordination_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: At most two natural drafts and zero retry; truncation or off-catalog routing fails without converting to proceed.

lead_coordination_submission.node_purpose: Map each completed Lead draft into the strict catalog-bound coordination decision contract.
lead_coordination_submission.input_scale: One Lead draft and its exact deterministic challenge-ID schema for each authorized coordination round.
lead_coordination_submission.required_outputs: One valid routing decision with locally bound Lead identity and schema version.
lead_coordination_submission.schema_burden: Accepted challenges must be a unique subset of the visible catalog and next state must remain internally consistent.
lead_coordination_submission.materiality_quality_risk: A mapping error could route an unauthorized repair or falsely declare readiness for evaluation.
lead_coordination_submission.comparable_run_evidence: The current submission adapter has already produced complete contract mappings without re-authoring research content.
lead_coordination_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA non-thinking submission profile because the research routing judgment already exists in the draft.
lead_coordination_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one Tool Call per Lead round and zero retry; invalid IDs, state or truncation fails closed.

role_repair_analysis.node_purpose: Let no more than three original specialist owners revise only the judgment surfaces challenged by Research Lead.
role_repair_analysis.input_scale: One validated workpaper, role-local context and one or more catalog-bound cross-role FeedbackReceipts per repair.
role_repair_analysis.required_outputs: A revised natural workpaper draft that resolves accepted challenges without changing authority reference sets.
role_repair_analysis.schema_burden: Repair context locks Evidence, NumericFact, relation and gap authority while retaining the complete workpaper structure.
role_repair_analysis.materiality_quality_risk: Repair must improve consistency without laundering a data or tool gap into a rewritten conclusion.
role_repair_analysis.comparable_run_evidence: The current zero-call repair path preserved all authority sets while resolving a ValueCapture challenge and passing Lead recheck.
role_repair_analysis.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA thinking-max with max_tokens 32000 because a material cross-role challenge requires real reconsideration.
role_repair_analysis.stop_and_truncation_behavior: At most three natural repair drafts and zero retry; truncation, scope drift or authority change fails closed.

role_repair_submission.node_purpose: Map each completed role-repair draft into the strict specialist Workpaper contract.
role_repair_submission.input_scale: One repair draft, the locked role context and its exact authority-constrained schema.
role_repair_submission.required_outputs: One valid repaired workpaper with exactly unchanged Evidence, numeric, relation and gap authority sets.
role_repair_submission.schema_burden: Nested claims and challenges remain valid while identity and schema metadata are bound locally.
role_repair_submission.materiality_quality_risk: Any authority-set change would allow a role to invent support while ostensibly answering Lead.
role_repair_submission.comparable_run_evidence: The current zero-call repair path proves authority-preserving validation and a separate Lead recheck.
role_repair_submission.reasoning_profile: DeepSeek GA non-thinking submission profile because this step preserves the completed repair judgment.
role_repair_submission.stop_and_truncation_behavior: Exactly one Tool Call per authorized repair and zero retry; truncation or authority drift fails closed.

known_boundary: R4 may reuse exactly the eight validated R3 captures, reconstruct Demand, Operating and Value without Provider calls, resume Cash at its unfinished natural workpaper, complete Supply's one missing current S1/S2 request, and then run bounded Lead coordination and authority-preserving repairs. It forbids whole-chain replay, reuse of the failed Cash draft, retries, external acquisition, Candidate promotion, pointer mutation, Harness-authored financial judgment, Writer, publication, S3 acceptance, generalization and release. Any new failure consumes the R4 identity and must be preserved at its exact frontier.
